tasks.description: Fix interleave_evenly so an empty iterable collection returns an empty result, including when lengths=[] is supplied explicitly. Keep the focused regression tests passing.

verifier.command: python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_more.py -k test_no_iterables -v

tasks.description: RawTokenFormatter crashes on Error tokens when error_color is enabled because text and bytes are mixed. Preserve binary output while applying the requested ANSI color.
Fix Click usage rendering for optional Choice and DateTime arguments whose metavars already contain brackets. The synopsis must not render a second pair of square brackets.

verifier.command: PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q tests/test_basic.py -k 'choice_argument_optional_metavar or datetime_argument_optional_metavar'

tasks.description: Fix reversed() on an empty numeric_range so it returns an empty iterator instead of raising IndexError.

verifier.command: python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_more.py -k test_empty_reversed -v

tasks.description: Fix repeat support in gray_product and partial_product when their inputs are iterators, so repeated dimensions are not exhausted after the first copy.

verifier.command: python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_more.py -k test_repeat_with_iterators -v

tasks.description: Fix chunked encoding of an empty Data event so it emits no bytes and cannot be confused with the terminating zero-length chunk.

verifier.command: python -m pytest -q h11/tests/test_connection.py h11/tests/test_io.py -k 'chunked or ChunkedWriter'

tasks.description: Deduplicate regex_opt input words so duplicate prefixes and single-character words do not produce redundant character classes such as [ss].
Fix repeat support in nth_product and product_index when input iterables are iterators, so repeated dimensions remain reusable during indexing.

verifier.command: python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_more.py -k test_repeat -v
